title: Family Guy Sets Hulu Release Date for 2026 Holiday Special – Watch First Look Trailer
content:
Family Guy is coming back to Hulu with a new holiday special later this month, and it has now set a release date with the streamer with the first trailer showing it all off. Family Guy has gone through a notable schedule shift in the last few years as with Fox moving it over to midseason, and it means that the Fall comes and goes without new seasons of the series . But thankfully, Family Guy has made up for it with holiday specials streaming with Hulu instead.

Much like seen with the last couple of years, Family Guy has been releasing two holiday specials exclusively with Hulu for the Halloween and Christmas holidays. Following the launch of this year’s Halloween special earlier this Fall , the new Christmas special episode is now set to make its debut with Hulu on November 30th. Giving fans the first look at what to expect from the new holiday special for the year, you can check out the new Family Guy trailer below.

When Does Family Guy ‘s 2026 Christmas Special Come Out?

“ Family Guy 2026 Holiday Special will be making its streaming debut with Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ on November 30th . Titled “The Peter Clause,” the synopsis for the episode teases it’s going to be as wacky of a time as it looks, It’s Christmas in Quahog, and Peter and the guys compete to become the town’s official Santa,” the synopsis begins before really getting into the meat of the matter for the episode. “Peter loses, and he can either process his disappointment in a mature manner, or give fans a memorable episode of ‘Family Guy.’ Thankfully, he chooses option number two.”

The Family Guy holiday specials have been a bit hit-or-miss thus far, but they have been moving in the right direction . The first time these specials came to Hulu as a result of the Fox schedule adjustment, it had initially seemed like they were just extra episodes produced during the usual season that had just been released in the gap. But as seen with the latest examples of the holiday specials, it’s clear that the production team really has gone all out for each occasion.

What’s Next for Family Guy in 2027?

Family Guy will be returning in full with Season 25 sometime early next year as part of the midseason schedule with Fox. No release date has not been announced as of this time, but it’s going to be released alongside new episodes of Bob’s Burgers at the same time (which has also now made the move to midseason starting next year). But there’s even much more of the animated franchise coming our way in the new year too with a whole new spinoff series.

Stewie is getting his own spinoff series titled Stewie. Releasing sometime in the 2027-2028 window , this new spinoff series will see Stewie heading to a new preschool and meeting a group of new characters. He’ll naturally still be involved with the main series, but now it’s all going to expand even further from then on. What do you think of this first look at Family Guy ‘s new holiday special for the year? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Singer Yukio Yamagata Dies at 69
content:
Yamagata was scheduled to perform at the "Super Sentai Soul XX 2026" concert in Tokyo on November 7, but was unable to attend due to illness. The concert's planner Birthday Song later revealed his death.

Yamagata was born on March 11, 1957, in Fukuoka Prefecture.

He performed the theme song for the live-action Hyakujuu Sentai Gaoranger and Unofficial Sentai Akibaranger tokusatsu series. He also performed theme songs for the Yattodetaman , Bakusō Kyōdai Let's & Go!! , Galactic Gale Baxinger , Nora , and Acrobunch - The Quest for Treasure anime.

He has also voiced characters in Soreike! Anpanman , Mobile Suit Victory Gundam , Iron Leaguer , and Digital Devil Story: Megami Tensei . He made a cameo appearance as himself in the live-action Unofficial Sentai Akibaranger series.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 Confirms Multiple Havens Will Be Revealed With First Story Details
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens has revealed the first details of what to expect from Season 2’s new story, and has teased that there will be the reveal of an unexpected new Haven than what has been previously teased thus far. The end of the debut season saw Pavi and Jae leave Ellora with the intent of journeying to the other Havens to not only help those in need, but unlock more of her chakra powers within her . But only the Floating Isles had been seen coming next.

Avatar: Seven Havens’ Season One finale teased that Pavi would be heading to the Floating Isles as the next major location on her journey, but the first story synopsis for Season 2 revealed by Paramount+ confirm that we’ll also see the New Ba Sing Se location before the season comes to an end. Which means there will be at least two of the Havens explored with the coming season of the series, and makes for a good pace towards its end.

Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 Confirms Floating Isles and New Ba Sing Se

“In Book 2, entitled ‘Discovery’, Pavi continues her chakra journey to the Floating Isles and learns more about what happened to Korra,” the synopsis for Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 begins as it further confirms the teases of more of Korra’s future in the coming season . But the synopsis also teases Nisha’s journey in the new episodes, “Meanwhile, Nisha discovers vital information about the mysterious spirit energy Pavi released from Ellora.” The juiciest detail comes towards the end of the synopsis as it sets up their reunion.

“The girls are brought together in New Ba Sing Se, along with all their unresolved issues,” the synopsis ends. Not only does this fully reveal that Pavi will be heading to the Floating Isles as seen with the first season finale, but Avatar: Seven Havens will also fully reveal the third of the Havens, New Ba Sing Se as Pavi and Nisha will be reunited. With Avatar: Seven Havens also revealing that it’s going to end with only four seasons , it does make sense that we’d see at least more than one Haven in the seasons to come in order to reach that end point within a suitable amount of time.

When Does Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 Come Out?

Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 Episodes 1-3 will be making their worldwide debut with Paramount+ on May 21, 2027, followed by the release of Episodes 4-6 on May 28th, Episodes 7-9 on June 4th, and the final batch of Episodes 10-13 on June 11th. Paramount+ has also confirmed that Season 3 of the series will then be following later in 2027 as well. With the series revealing it’s going to end with Season 4 soon after, it’s likely that it’s all going to wrap up by 2028 with all four seasons completely the story.

Avatar: Seven Havens is setting up even more looks into Korra’s life after The Legend of Korra in the coming season , and that’s going to be more important as Pavi’s own life as the Avatar develops even further. Given how big of a response the series has gotten with its first season alone, it’s likely going to be even bigger with more locations, more powers, and more lore unlocked.

How are you feeling about Avatar: Seven Havens so far? What do you want to see in the second season? Let us know all of your thoughts about in the comments.

title: After 9 Years, Black Clover Finally Reveals Noelle’s True Feelings for Asta
content:
Black Clover has been sitting on this one ever since the TV anime kicked off its run nearly a decade ago, but the newest episode of the second season has finally seen Noelle Silva accept her real feelings of love for Asta. Black Clover Season 2 has been working its way through the Spade Kingdom Raid arc, and it has pit Asta and the others against the Dark Triad through all of the episodes seen thus far. It’s been a particularly tough arc for Noelle amidst all of it too.

After Noelle had lost to Vanica back in the first season of the series, Black Clover Season 2 has been able to show off the fruits of her mana training in the Heart Kingdom. This has made her stronger than ever before as she’s been surviving thus far, and the latest episode of the series sees Noelle pushing beyond her limits once Asta arrives to help her . It’s through seeing Asta in this situation that Noelle herself realizes that she really does love him as he’s been able to get her back to her senses.

Black Clover Season 2 Finally Confirms Noelle’s Love for Asta

Black Clover Season 2 Episode 7 continues the fight against the Supreme Devil Megicula after she emerged from Vanica’s body. Noelle and the others had hit a wall through the limits of her power, but Asta soon arrives to help with his anti-magic just in time to keep Megicula from killing Lolopechka with a suicidal magic explosion. This gives Noelle the hope she needed to keep going on, and it’s in this moment that Noelle realizes what she has been fighting back against this whole time. Because while she was telling herself different, she really does love Asta.

Knowing that Asta had already been recklessly pushing beyond his own limits to even help in that moment, Noelle realizes that he’s put his complete faith in her. In the moment she knows that just the fact that he came to save her at all, and just in thinking about Asta while she fights, it’s enough for Noelle to push through for one final attack against Megicula. It’s in this thought giving her strength that Noelle accepts her true feelings, and now moves forward with all of that in mind at last.

What Does This Mean for Noelle’s Future in Black Clover ?

Noelle has been the third major character in the series along with Asta and Yuno as she’s gotten plenty of development and improvement over all of the arcs thus far. This arc sees her become a Saint Stage level fighter with the use of Undine , and through that ability she’s able to deal the final blow to the Supreme Devil. It’s going to keep her in the action as everything continues to ramp up from here on out, but Asta’s still going to be much further away than that.

We’ve only seen Asta show any kind of romantic interest in his childhood crush, Sister Lily, so it’s unclear how he views Noelle or her romantic rival Mimosa Vermilion. He’s been squarely focused on fighting and getting stronger, but their time together as Black Bulls has made Noelle a dear friend to Asta until now. We’ll just have to see if Noelle actually acts on her feelings, so how do you feel about this development? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Earns US$8 Million in 73% Drop at U.S. Box Office, Passes US$100 Million Worldwide
content:
In related news, Legendary Entertainment 's new live-action film of CAPCOM 's Street Fighter game series dropped from #11 to #16 in the U.S. box office, earning about US$760,000 last weekend. The film has also earned over US$100 million worldwide. The Street Fighter film opened on October 16, ranking #1 in the United States, and earning US$30,775,377 in its first three days.

Godzilla Minus Zero earned an estimated US$31.61 million at the North American box office in its opening weekend. A record 74% of that total came from premium large format screenings, with 40% or US$12 million from IMAX screenings. (It is the first Japanese film to meet the standard to advertise itself as "filmed for IMAX.")

This is the highest ever U.S. opening weekend for a GKIDS release (higher than The Boy and the Heron 's US$13 million in 2023 ), as well as the highest one ever for a live-action foreign film. (The highest one for a foreign film is still the first Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle anime film with US$70.6 million, unadjusted for inflation, in September 2025. The English dub of Pokémon: The First Movie opened with US$50.8 million in its first five days in July 1998.)

Godzilla Minus Zero 's global revenue stands at US$63 million after its opening weekend. Deadline reports it was the highest-grossing film in the world this past weekend.

The film earned 590,000 tickets for 910 million yen (about US$5.75 million) in Japan in its opening day alone, setting a new record for the highest opening day earnings for a live-action film (among both foreign and domestic live-action films) in Japan. The film had 201% higher opening day earnings than its predecessor Godzilla Minus One in Japan.

The film opened in Japan on Tuesday, November 3, which is "Godzilla Day" in Japan, celebrating the anniversary of the first Godzilla film's November 3, 1954 release. Godzilla Minus One similarly opened in Japan on November 3, 2023. (Godzilla Day fell on a Tuesday this year, but it is also the Japanese holiday known as Culture Day.)

The sequel is set in 1949, two years after the Godzilla Minus One film's story.

title: Crunchyroll’s Most Viral Anime of 2027 Confirms Early Premiere With Major Event
content:
There’s been one anime that has already gone viral with fans ahead of its debut with Crunchyroll next year, and it’s now been confirmed that the streaming service will be holding an early premiere for the new series during a major event coming soon. 2027 is going to be packed with a ton of new anime releases that fans are already keeping an eye out for, but there’s one that fans of the manga have been eager to see make its anime adaptation debut.

The anime adaptation for Sumiko Arai’s The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy at All will be making its full debut in January to help kick off the new year of anime releases , but Crunchyroll has now confirmed they will be hosting an early premiere for the new series as part of Anime Frontier 2026 taking place over the December 4-6 weekend at the Fort Worth Convention Center in Fort Worth, Texas. It’ll be the first chance fans get to see it in action before its full premiere next year.

Crunchyroll Confirms Early Premiere for The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy at All

The early premiere for The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy at All will be taking place on Sunday, December 6th for those in attendance at Anime Frontier 2026. The first episode of the new anime will be one of the premieres that Aniplex will be offering together with the first episodes of other upcoming 2027 hits like Bless, Here U Are, and Dengeki Daisy. But out of all of the premieres, this one is likely the anime that fans are most excited to see in action as soon as possible .

The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy at All is currently slated for its full premiere next January as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule, but has yet to confirm a release date as of this time. The new anime will be directed by will be directed by Masashi Ishihama for CloverWorks (the studio behind hits like My Dress-Up Darling and Spy x Family ) with Rino Yamazaki handling the composition for the series, and Kanna Hirayama providing the character designs. But additional staff and voice cast have yet to be revealed.

What to Know for The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy at All Anime

The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy at All will be streaming exclusively with Crunchyroll outside of Japan when it finally makes its debut, and it will even feature Nirvana’s “Breed” as its official opening theme. With more details for the new series to be revealed ahead of its January premiere, this early look at the first episode is going to be one of the most substantial updates for the series yet. If you’re in the area you’ll want to look into it for sure.

The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy at All is a romance series that fans have been begging to see adapted ever since it made its debut back in 2022. The trailers for the anime have reached millions of hits within a very short time, and it’s hard not to see why as its central duo of girls have a quite a unique path for their potential romantic connection. But how are you feeling about The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy at All anime so far? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: LiSA, BABYMETAL Earn Nominations for 2027 Grammy Awards' New Best Asian Pop Music Performance Category
content:
Works released between August 31, 2025-August 28, 2026 are eligible for the awards. The awards ceremony will take place on February 7, 2027 at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles. It will air and stream on ABC , Disney+ , and Hulu . The 2027 Grammy Awards Premiere Ceremony will take place earlier that day at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles.

The 2027 Grammys will feature five new Grammy Categories: Best Asian Pop Music Performance, Best R&B Collaboration or Duo/Group Performance, Best Traditional Pop Vocal Performance, Best Traditional Folk Album, and Best Latin Song.

Composer Winifred Phillips won the "Best Score Soundtrack for Video Games and Other Interactive Media" award for the 3D remake of the original Wizardry: Proving Grounds of the Mad Overlord game at the 67th annual Grammys in 2025.

LiSA performed theme songs for Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba , Demon Slayer – Kimetsu no Yaiba – The Movie: Mugen Train , that film's seven-episode television anime version Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Mugen Train Arc , and Sword Art Online the Movie -Progressive- Aria of a Starless Night . title: Yu-Gi-Oh Drops Special Trailer for New Shonen Jump 30th Anniversary Release – Watch
content:
Yu-Gi-Oh! is set to release a special version of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine to celebrate its 30th anniversary, and has dropped a special trailer to help celebrate the occasion. Kazuki Takahashi’s classic manga series first made its debut back in 1996 as a much different kind of series than it’s now for today. Thanks to that early pivot, the franchise has now gone on for three decades, multiple sequels, spinoffs and more in all the time since. And it’s just as popular now as it ever has been.

Yu-Gi-Oh! has officially kicked off its 30th anniversary celebration in Japan with all sorts of special new events to commemorate the occasion , and Shonen Jump is going all out with a special version of the magazine featuring some of the biggest duels from the series’ past. While this new edition of the magazine is unfortunately only going to be available in Japan for now, fans can see what the fuss is all about with a special trailer showing it off. You can check it out below.

Yu-Gi-Oh! Celebrates 30th Anniversary With New Special Events and Projects

As Yu-Gi-Oh! hits its 30th anniversary milestone , the franchise is going all out in Japan. “YU-GI-OH! ART WORKS” has been revealed as a special new art exhibition showing off the late Kazuki Takahashi’s original work, but no potential international plans for it have been revealed as of this time. Though the franchise did have something else for everyone to enjoy with a new anime short directed by Eri Osada for KONAMI animation with Takahiro Kagami providing the character designs, and Haruka Taira serving as art director.

Yu-Gi-Oh! will also be releasing a special digital art book in Japan later this Fall to help cement this 30th anniversary, and while there’s no international release planned for that either it’s yet another fun way the franchise is returning. But it doesn’t beat a potential return for the anime franchise as it’s perfect for a remake anime series taking it on from the very beginning. With the franchise hitting this major milestone, it would be the perfect time to bring the classic anime back to the spotlight.

Will Yu-Gi-Oh! Ever Get an Anime Remake?

Yu-Gi-Oh! made a major pivot early into its run as Kazuki Takahashi shifted away from the darker death games seen in the earliest chapters to instead focus more on the trading card game battles the franchise would then be most well known for. This has made it such a massive hit over the decades that the anime would continue with a number of different iterations with new generations of stories and main characters playing their own versions of the card game from then on.

But while Yu-Gi-Oh! has found success with all of its other future generations that followed, the original series has remained in a stasis . Outside of coming back with a movie event, Yu-Gi-Oh! The Dark Side of Dimensions , back in 2016 to celebrate its 20th anniversary, the franchise is poised and ready for another new take. Though that might be tough without Takahashi around to oversee it. Can you believe it’s been 30 years of Yu-Gi-Oh ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: New Garfield Revival Animated Series Confirms Release Date With First Look Trailer – Watch
content:
Garfield is coming back to screens with a new 2D animated series hitting Paramount+ sooner than you think, and it has now confirmed its release date with its first trailer showing off the new revival in motion. Jim Davis’ Garfield comics franchise is still one of the most popular icons of all time, and has seen a number of different adaptations and iterations over the years . But this new animated series coming our way seems to be one of the most faithful to the original comics’ designs yet.

Garfield is a new animated series coming to Paramount+ on December 11th, and returns the animated cat to his 2D roots with a slate of designs that look as close to Davis’ comics as fans could hope for after the franchise’s most recent CG animated outing unfortunately failed to meet expectations . But with this new take on the franchise reviving the TV series for a new era, you can check out the first look at the new Garfield below ahead of its streaming launch.

New Garfield Animated Series Comes to Paramount+ This December

Garfield will be making its streaming debut with Paramount+ on December 11th. It has yet to confirm how many episodes is debut season will be running for, but all episodes will be launching with the streaming service at the same time. Paramount is going to be counting down to the premiere of the new animated series beginning on Monday, November 23rd with “I Hate Mondays,” a series of shorts featuring this new take on the icon releasing with the NickToons YouTube channel to give fans an idea of what to expect.

This new take on Garfield has been created by Dave H. Johnson and John Trabbic III for Nickelodeon Animation Studios with Adrian Younge and Ali Shaheed Muhammad (of A Tribe Called Quest) composing the music. The new version of the famous feline will be voiced by Emmy award winning star Lamorne Morris (who was most recently seen in action with Spider-Noir), and thankfully this version of Garfield is communicating through his thoughts alone like the comics rather than openly speaking like seen with some adaptations.

What to Know for New Garfield Animated Series

Garfield ‘s new animated outing will feature a stacked voice cast including Joe Brogie as Jon Arbuckle, co-creator Dave H. Johnson as Odie, Alex Cazares as Nermal, Michelle Ortiz as Arlene, Molly Bernard as Liz, Salli Saffioti as Jo/Mama, co-creator John Trabbic III as Floyd, Greg Beharrell as Paulie, Grey DeLisle as Mom/Granny, John DiMaggio as Victor, Major Attaway as Dhonathan, Sean Giambrone as Josh, and Brent Mukai as Roland. And Paramount+ teases how it’s all been updated for the modern era .

Garfield moves the titular cat and Jon to the big city, but makes sure to keep the icon’s “sarcasm, selfishness, and unapologetic laziness” from Jim Davis’ original comics as teased by the series’ press release. This first look trailer sees how he has adapted to newer technologies, but hopefully keeps the spirit intact without going too far in that direction for its stories.

We’ll see for ourselves soon enough, but how are you feeling about this new Garfield animated series so far? What do you think of this first look? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Officially Confirms When Its Story Will End
content:
Avatar: Seven Havens might be currently on the way with Season 2 of the animated series next year, but Paramount+ has already confirmed when the story for the new series is going to end. Avatar: Seven Havens made its successful debut with its premiere season this Fall, and quickly confirmed that three more seasons of the animated series were already in the works. This has been a great sign for the future, but the end is going to hit much sooner than fans expect.

The showrunners behind Avatar: Seven Havens had previously noted in interviews that the animated series will be ending after its fourth season , and now Paramount+ has indeed confirmed this to be the case as a recent press release for the animated series has revealed “The series will conclude with Book 4, with premiere details to be announced at a later date.” This means four seasons for this new era of the Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise in total to tell its story.

Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms It Will End With Season 4

Avatar: Seven Havens has been taking a much different approach with its story and release than seen with The Legend of Korra . “This one was designed more with a clear end, kind of the way we did with Avatar[: The Last Airbender], where we had pitched the whole story out,” franchise co-creator Michael DiMartino stated about the series’ plan with GamesRadar+. Rather than extend its story beyond its originally planned single season outing like seen with The Legend of Korra, Avatar: Seven Havens had begun with this endpoint already in mind.

It’s also going to be produced at a much quicker rate than fans might have expected as well. Avatar: Seven Havens showrunner Sehaj Sethi confirmed to ComicBook ahead of the debut season’s release that they were already in production on Seasons 3 and 4 as of that time. With Season 2 scheduled to release next year and the third season not long after that, it likely means that Avatar: Seven Havens will be ending with Season 4 on Paramount+ sometime in 2028.

When Does Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 Come Out?

It won’t be too much longer before we see what’s coming next as the release schedule for Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2 confirms Episodes 1-3 will be making their worldwide debut with Paramount+ on May 21, 2027, followed by the release of Episodes 4-6 on May 28th, Episodes 7-9 on June 4th, and the final batch of Episodes 10-13 on June 11th. It has also been confirmed that Season 3 will be coming to the streaming service later in 2027, so it won’t be that much of a wait between the seasons either.

With Avatar: Seven Havens Season 3 confirming it’s going to release in 2027, and a likely 2028 release for Season 4 after, that means fans are going to get quite a lot of this new era of the franchise within the next two years. Coupled with the also in development spinoff prequel series, Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos , likely releasing in this window as well, and fans have quite a lot to look forward to. Do you think four seasons is enough for Avatar: Seven Havens ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.
